is connected (in particular nonempty).
\end{enumerate}
If $Z = Z_1 \amalg Z_2$ with $Z_i$ closed in $Z$,
then there exists a decomposition $X = X_1 \amalg X_2$ with
$X_i$ closed in $X$ and $Z_i = Z \cap X_i$.
